<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rapid Hybridization](/Feats.aspx?ID=5513) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

**Trigger**
You roll initiative.

</column>

---

When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice. You use Change Shape to enter your hybrid shape.
name: Rapid Hybridization
